svg.title: One function, four views
svg.desc: The recorded run of rea function on ledger-arm64-O1 for _percent_change with the Ghidra provider, drawn as machines on one bench. You call rea 6.7.0, which hands the question to the BinarySession bound to ghidra, which calls the GhidraClient over bridge.sock, which launches Ghidra 12.1.4 as a headless JVM that imports and analyzes the artifact ledger-arm64-O1, a mach-o arm64 executable of 33872 bytes drawn as a stack of its file segments: __TEXT 16384 bytes, __DATA_CONST 16384 bytes, and __LINKEDIT 1104 bytes. The 24 bytes of _percent_change sit at 0x100000500 near the top of __TEXT. Three columns show the same function: the C you wrote in ledger.c, the pseudocode Ghidra decompiled with a second zero check the source never had, and the six instructions clang -O1 made from cbz w0 at 0x100000500 to ret at 0x100000514. The Evidence record ev_b492c85e at the bottom names the operation analyze_function, the provider ghidra 12.1.4, confidence observed, ten limitations, and the subject.
